text: Nozick's 'experience machine' thought experiment is standardly deployed as an objection to...
choices: hedonism about well-being (the view that well-being consists solely in pleasant experience)
explanation: If we would decline a machine guaranteeing maximally pleasant experiences, we apparently value things beyond felt pleasure -- reality, actually doing and being certain things -- which tells against hedonism about well-being. The thought experiment is not aimed at personal-identity theories, compatibilism, or the identity theory of mind.
